Workday Analyst

Configuration

  • Recommend innovative solutions to deploy Workday functionality and promote adoption.
  • Continually research and stay up to date on all Workday updates and fixes, including performing system testing for Workday delivered twice a year release.
  • Ensure processes are configured within SOX guidelines.
  • Lead projects for new functionality deployment and annual processes.
  • Maintain up to date documentation on all system configurations.

  • 2+ years of Workday HCM Configuration experience in at least 2 of these modules, Recruiting, Learning, Advanced Compensation, Talent, Payroll, Absence, Time Tracking, Benefits.
  • Experience with Workday Reporting and Dashboards including Advanced Reports.
  • Deep understanding of Workday data and structure, business processes, reporting, security, integrations and authentication capabilities.
  • Strong testing and release management experience.
  • Detail oriented, with strong follow-up skills.

  • Strong communication & collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast paced environment.

jobs.description:
Business Analyst

Job Title: Business Analyst Location: KL, Kuala Lumpur 

Job Overview

We are looking for a Business Analyst to act as a hands-on bridge between business stakeholders, technology teams and project teams. The Business Analyst will be responsible for understanding business needs, translating requirements into clear and actionable documentation, supporting solution definition and ensuring that requirements are correctly translated into execution.

Key Responsibilities

•Engage with business stakeholders to understand business processes, objectives and requirements.

•Conduct requirement-gathering workshops, interviews and discussions.

•Analyse and document As-Is and To-Be business processes.

•Translate business requirements into clear functional requirements and specifications.

•Prepare Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Functional Requirements Documents (FRD), user stories, use cases and process flows as required.

•Identify gaps, dependencies, assumptions, risks and business impacts.

•Work closely with development and technical teams to clarify requirements during implementation.

•Ensure delivered functionality aligns with approved requirements.

•Review proposed solutions from a business and functional perspective.

•Support development teams during implementation by providing requirement clarification.

•Prepare and maintain acceptance criteria and support UAT planning and execution.

•Coordinate with stakeholders to validate UAT results and manage requirement-related defects.

•Track requirement changes and maintain appropriate documentation and traceability.

•Participate in project meetings and provide regular status updates.

•Support project managers in identifying delivery risks, dependencies and requirement-related issues.

•Ensure documentation remains current throughout the project lifecycle.


Requirements

•Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science or a related discipline.

•3–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably within banking, financial services or investment banking.

•Strong requirement-gathering and documentation skills.

•Experience with BRD, FRD, user stories, use cases and process mapping.

•Understanding of SDLC and Agile/Waterfall delivery methodologies.

•Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

•Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

•Ability to work effectively with both business and technical teams.

•Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

•Experience with Jira, Confluence or similar project-management/documentation tools is an advantage.


Key Competencies

•Requirements analysis

•Business process modelling

•Documentation

•Stakeholder management

•Analytical thinking

•Communication

•Problem solving

•UAT support

•Delivery coordination


Preferred Experience

•Banking / Investment Banking

•Core banking / financial applications

•Large enterprise technology implementations

jobs.title: Sr Corporate Systems Endpoint Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

DoubleVerify is the leader in digital performance solutions, improving the impression quality and audience impact of digital advertising. Built on best practices, DoubleVerify solutions create value for media buyers and sellers by bringing transparency and accountability to the market, ensuring ad viewability, brand safety, fraud protection, accurate impression delivery, and audience quality across campaigns to drive performance.

Since 2008, DoubleVerify has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most value out of their media spend by delivering best-in-class solutions across the digital ecosystem that help build a better industry.

Overview

Reporting to the IT Manager, Corporate Systems and based at DoubleVerify's NYC Global HQ, the Corporate Systems Endpoint Engineer, MDM is the owner of how every DoubleVerify laptop is enrolled, configured, secured, and kept current. You'll run our device management platforms, Jamf Pro for macOS and Workspace ONE for Windows and Linux, across a global fleet of more than 1,600 devices. When a security control needs to reach every endpoint, an OS release needs to land without disruption, or a device quietly drifts out of compliance, you're the engineer who makes it happen.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of IT, Security, and DevOps. You'll be the trusted deployment partner for InfoSec and engineering teams, pushing security agents, certificates, browser controls, and developer tool settings to the fleet. If you love building automation instead of repeating manual work (Terraform-managed configuration, CI/CD pipelines, smart groups that detect and fix problems before users notice), this role is built for you. You'll work alongside a global Corporate Systems team across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, and help shape how a company manages its endpoints at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and administer our MDM platforms- manage policies, configuration profiles, enrollment (Apple Automated Device Enrollment and Windows Autopilot), smart groups, and security baselines in Jamf Pro and Workspace ONE across macOS, Windows, and Linux.
  • Be the deployment partner for Security and DevOps- package, deploy, and troubleshoot security agents, certificates, browser controls, and developer tool configurations through MDM; drive security findings and audit items to resolution.
  • Keep the fleet healthy and compliant- monitor device health daily (agent status, FileVault, MDM connectivity, inactive devices) and resolve failures; build detection and auto-remediation logic using extension attributes, smart groups, and scripted policies.
  • Manage OS updates and lifecycle readiness- own the macOS and Windows update strategy, scheduled-restart workflows, and pre-upgrade compatibility checks for each major OS release.
  • Steward critical Apple and vendor credentials- maintain and renew the APNs push certificate, Apple Business Manager enrollment and App Store tokens, and platform licensing on schedule, with documented, shared ownership so nothing depends on one person.
  • Integrate identity with the endpoint- support Okta Device Access for macOS, Windows Hello for Business, and endpoint-related Entra ID configuration.
  • Lead endpoint projects- drive initiatives such as browser enforcement, managed AI tool settings, Jamf Blueprints adoption, and migration and loaner-device workflows from pilot through full rollout.
  • Serve as the endpoint escalation point and vendor contact- act as the escalation path for MDM and device issues, approve exceptions per SOP, and manage the relationship with Jamf and other endpoint vendors.
  • Keep inventory and documentation accurate- reconcile device inventory across MDM platforms and asset records, and maintain runbooks and end-user knowledge base articles.

Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in endpoint engineering or systems administration in a corporate environment.
  • Deep, hands-on Jamf Pro administration experience (policies, configuration profiles, PreStage enrollment, smart groups, extension attributes) - must.
  • Experience managing Windows devices with Workspace ONE, or equivalent, including Autopilot - must.
  • Working knowledge of Apple Business Manager, APNs, ADE, and VPP - must.
  • Experience deploying and supporting security tooling (EDR, vulnerability scanners, certificate-based network access) through MDM - must.
  • Experience with ITSM/ticketing platforms (Freshservice, ServiceNow, or equivalent).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD (Terraform, GitLab or GitHub pipelines) - advantage.
  • Experience with Okta, Entra ID, or similar identity platforms, including Okta Device Access or Platform SSO - advantage.
  • Linux endpoint management experience - an advantage.
  • Jamf certifications (Jamf 200/300/400) - advantage.
  • Strong communication skills - comfortable partnering with Security, DevOps, and senior stakeholders and explaining technical change to end users.
  • Self-starter with an automation-first mindset, strong documentation habits, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities across project work and day-to-day operations.

jobs.title: Data Quality Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Title: Data Pipeline / Test Engineer –

AI-Enhanced Data Quality & Automation

Department: Quality Engineering / Engineering Excellence

Employment Type: Full-Time / Contract to Hire / Contractor

Role: Sr. QE Engineer

Required Experience Range : 8+

About the Role

We are looking for a Data Pipeline / QE Engineer with deep expertise in testing large-scale

batch and streaming data processing systems. The role involves ensuring end-to-end data

quality, reliability, and integrity across modern data pipelines on GCP, AWS, or Azure

ecosystems.

You’ll design and implement Python-based test automation frameworks that validate ingestion,

transformation, and aggregation of data in ETL/ELT pipelines, leveraging AI-assisted testing

approaches (Prompt Engineering, MCP, Copilot/Cursor) to improve speed and accuracy of

validation.

This role is ideal for someone who can bridge data engineering, automation, and AI, ensuring

that streaming and batch data flows powering analytics, ML models, and business dashboards

are tested comprehensively and intelligently.

Role Impact

Your work will directly ensure the accuracy and reliability of high-volume data pipelines that

feed analytics, machine learning, and campaign optimization platforms. By building intelligent

validation frameworks and synthetic data systems, you will play a pivotal role in enabling

trusted, production-grade data across the organization’s AI and decision intelligence

ecosystems.

Key Responsibilities

Data Pipeline & ETL Testing

● Design, implement, and maintain automated test suites for validating batch and

streaming data ingestion pipelines.

● Test data ingestion from Google Cloud Storage (GCS), APIs, and real-time streaming

sources (e.g., Pub/Sub, Kafka, Kinesis).

● Validate data transformations, schema evolution, and data aggregation logic in ETL/ELT

pipelines using Python and SQL.

● Build monitoring and alerting frameworks to proactively detect data drift, schema

changes, and anomalies in data flow.

Data Systems & Tooling

● Perform validation and performance testing on data stored in BigQuery, Snowflake,

Looker, or equivalent data warehouses.

● Test integration between data lake, warehouse, and reporting layers, ensuring accurate

metrics propagation.

● Work with Airflow DAGs to validate job dependencies, schedule integrity, and pipeline

orchestration.

● Collaborate with Data Engineers to improve observability and testability of ETL/ELT

processes.

Test Automation & AI-Augmented Frameworks

● Develop Python-based test automation frameworks for validating batch and streaming

data pipelines.

● Use Prompt Engineering to accelerate test case generation, data transformation

validation, and anomaly detection logic.

● Leverage Codex / GitHub Copilot / Cursor to implement high-quality, context-aware test

scripts with defined guardrails and context rules.

● Utilize MCP (Model Context Protocol) for dynamic data validation workflows and

contextual test management (MCP usage is mandatory).

● (Optional) Integrate OpenAI APIs or other LLMs for smart test analysis, log

summarization, or auto-healing test design.

Test Data Modelling & Synthetic Data Generation

● Design and maintain test data models aligned with production data schemas and

business metrics.

● Generate synthetic data using configurable rules, statistical patterns, and metric

definitions derived from production datasets.

● Validate data distribution, quality metrics, and referential integrity for both synthetic

and real datasets.

● Work with analytics teams to ensure data used in testing accurately represents

production scale, shape, and edge cases.

Required Skills & Qualifications

● Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field.

● Strong hands-on experience in testing batch and streaming data pipelines.

● Expertise with BigQuery or equivalent (Redshift, Synapse, etc.).

● Experience with Snowflake, Looker, or similar analytics systems on AWS or Azure.

● Advanced SQL skills — joins, window functions, CTEs, query optimization, and complex

validation queries.

● Solid knowledge of Python for data validation and test automation.

● Experience working with Airflow DAGs and data orchestration frameworks.

● Proven experience in data modeling, synthetic data generation, and defining data

validation rulesets.

jobs.description:
Job Description – Data Engineer (Intermediate) (SSRS Focus)

Experience-3-5 years

Department

Technology Application / Data & Integration Services

Job Grade

Executive / Senior Executive

Job Summary

The Data Engineer is primarily responsible for the design, development, enhancement, and support of enterprise reporting solutions using SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS). The role will also support Microsoft SQL Server database development, ETL processes, system integrations, reporting automation, and secure file transfer solutions.

The successful candidate will work closely with business users and application teams to deliver operational, management, regulatory, and analytical reports while ensuring data accuracy, report performance, and system reliability.



Key Responsibilities

Reporting Solutions Development (Primary Responsibility)

  • Design, develop, deploy, and maintain reports using SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS).
  • Convert business requirements into functional and user-friendly reports.
  • Develop and optimise report datasets, parameters, subscriptions, and report scheduling.
  • Produce operational, management, financial, regulatory, and ad-hoc reports.
  • Troubleshoot report performance and optimise data retrieval efficiency.
  • Work directly with stakeholders to gather and analyse reporting requirements.
  • Ensure report accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery.

Database Development & Support

  • Develop and maintain Microsoft SQL Server database objects including:
  • Stored Procedures
  • Functions
  • Views
  • Triggers
  • Create and optimise T-SQL scripts to support reporting and integration requirements.
  • Perform query analysis and performance tuning.
  • Support production database troubleshooting and issue resolution.
  • Monitor and support SQL Server Agent jobs.

ETL & Data Integration

  • Develop and maintain ETL processes using SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
  • Support data extraction, transformation, and loading activities.
  • Develop and maintain system interfaces and integration processes.
  • Perform data validation and reconciliation across source and target systems.
  • Troubleshoot integration and data transfer issues.

Automation, Secure File Transfer & Encryption

  • Develop operational and monitoring scripts using PowerShell.
  • Support automated file transfers via SSH/SFTP.
  • Support data encryption and decryption processes using PGP/GPG.
  • Automate reporting and file processing activities.
  • Monitor and support batch processing activities.

Production Support

  • Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for reporting, database, and integration-related incidents.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.
  • Support deployment, change management, and disaster recovery activities.
  • Ensure adherence to service level agreements (SLAs).

Documentation & Governance

  • Maintain technical documentation and operational procedures.
  • Prepare report specifications, data mappings, and support documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with internal security, audit, and governance standards.


Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or related disciplines.

Experience

  • Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in Microsoft SQL Server technologies.
  • Strong hands-on experience in SSRS report development.
  • Experience supporting production reporting environments.
  • Banking or financial services experience is an advantage.
